'''R4-C2'''<ref name="Episode Guide">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/in-the-name-of-the-rebellion-trivia-gallery|text="In the Name of the Rebellion" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}}</ref> was an [[R4 astromech droid|R4 astromech]] [[droid]] in service to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. The droid relayed a [[Hologram|holographic]] message from the extremist [[Saw Gerrera]] to members of the [[Massassi Group]] at the [[Great Temple]] on [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="In the Name of the Rebellion" />
